propositions: BindingRepository must preserve exact byte layout, serialization order (sorted/indented/trailing newline), and load behavior from legacy dictionaries without eager writes on construction.
Unconditional save must attempt rotation persistence before live file replacement, retaining inline floor value across partial-state failures.

Rotation tempfile/write/replace failure leaves rotation sidecar old, live file new with retained inline floor, and does not raise; subsequent save must converge sidecar from the floor without re-corrupting live.
Corrupt live JSON raises ValueError and preserves the file; corrupt retired JSON returns empty, preserves the file, and attempts best-effort deduped alerting; alert failure is swallowed.

Live or retired file persistence failure (tempfile, write, or replace) leaves the file old, cleans any tempfile, and raises; alert failure after successful state write is swallowed and does not alter the result.
